test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, "She is the only daughter of the only child of my grandmother." How is the woman related to the girl in the photograph?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png] 

Given:

"My grandmother" refers to the woman's grandmother.

"The only child of my grandmother" must be the woman's parent (either her mother or father).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74d62211b63068ccccd99d03bc6e17bd7a192096c6b8c66d66c9d89551c214e6.png] 

Thus, the only daughter of the only child of my grandmother refers to herself.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
